question:
**Select the most appropriate option that can substitute the underlined segment in the given sentence.**

Despite being his competitor, John was __generous and forgiving__ in defeat and congratulated his opponent on his well-deserved victory.
solution:
The correct answer is: **magnanimous**

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/36f36cd5ece4186095afcf2ffbfb7b80cc04b6c2e3226e7477a419a9fbc96f85.png] **__Key Points__**

__
 
• **Magnanimous **is an adjective that describes someone who is **generous**, **forgiving**, and noble in spirit, especially in times of victory or power. (**महानुभाव**)

 
 
• **Example**: *Despite facing harsh criticism, the magnanimous leader responded with kindness and understanding.*
 
 
 
• *​*Hence, the most appropriate word that can substitute the underlined segment is 'magnanimous'.

Therefore, the correct answer is **option 2**.

 [IMAGE: https://cdn.repeatermock.com/tb/f13e2ad6582c16aa62a83672e2547ad20a01fddb61962a1acce42eb9a1a99caa.png] **Additional Information__**

 
• **Altruistic: **Selflessly concerned for the well-being of others. (**परोपकारी**)
 
• **Fainthearted: **Lacking courage or determination; timid. (**डरपोक**)
 
• **Venomous: **Full of malice or spite; capable of inflicting harm. (**विषैला**)
